records.title: Development of Etawah Safari Park
details: a to c: Government of India in 2024-25 sanctioned the projects ‘Development of Bateshwar in District-Agra’ for Rs. 74.05 Crore and ‘Integrated Buddhist Tourism Development in Shrawasti’ for Rs. 80.24 Crore in the State of Uttar Pradesh under its initiative for ‘Special Assistance to States for Capital Investment (SASCI)-Development of Iconic Tourist Centres to Global Scale’.
